references.text: Rahab hid the spies and lied to the king's men about their whereabouts, a similar situation where a woman protects refugees by lying
Abraham stood at the tent entrance and met guests, thematically linked to standing at the tent doorway
Lot sat in the city gate and received guests, a similar motif of hospitality and protection of visitors
The same narrative where Jael invites Sisera into her tent, direct context for this instruction
The continuation of the story where Jael kills Sisera while he sleeps, the result of the deception he sought
Mikal helped David escape and lied to Saul's men, a similar theme where a woman lies to protect someone
